note: The Lean concludes the same by an algebraic identity chain with `ad_antisym` and `linear_zero` instead of the argument that ad(JX) is both self-adjoint and skew-adjoint.

snippet.text:
have hW (x y z : G.Color) : A (G.ad x y) z = - A (G.ad y x) z := by nth_rw 1 [ad_antisym]; simp
  have he (x y z : G.Color) : A (G.ad x y) z = 0 := by linarith [hI x y z,hW x z y,hI z x y,hW z y x,hI y z x,hW y x z]
  apply invariant_scalar H B (fun x y => sub_eq_zero.mp ?_) hi
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (linear_zero H (A.flip y) (fun _ _ => he _ _ _)) x

proof_context.conclusion: The skew part vanishes (`he`, via `hW` and `hI`), so the form is a scalar multiple of the inner product and the color coefficient is the one given by a unit test vector (`coeff`).
